season.evidence: WTA/guide search: roughly June-October, stream fords high into July, larches late Sep-early Oct; stored text mid-July to early October. Peakbagger months cluster Jun-Oct.

track.why: Only route in catalog; logged "West Fork Buttermilk trail", Aug 1 round trip of 16 mi from the trailhead (start 37 m, end 27 m from our pin), summit within 21 m, follows trail to Fish Creek Pass then the SE ridge boulders.

otherTracksConsidered.why: one-way recording, ends far from trailhead
June, partial segment of a linkup

facts.text: Past the washout roughly three miles in, fallen trees still need to be climbed over in early October, and the creek is crossed on a log; flagging marks the easiest line through the washout.
In early October the outlet stream of Star Lake is the easy water source for a camp near the pass, and the lakeside sites fill up.
A bootpath climbs the ridge directly from Fish Creek Pass; it is easy to follow by headlamp for a sunrise summit in early October.
In late June the pass can still hold melting snow and Star Lake is mostly iced over; plan for wet ground and cold nights.
Early October brings peak larch colour around the pass and Star Lake, with weekend crowds on the trail.

notes: Several recordings are multi-peak days (Star/Oval) so only the one Courtney-only round trip was assigned.
